hooks.command: [ "${CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE:-}" = true ] || exit 0; D=/opt/dotfiles; if [ -d "$D/.git" ]; then git -C "$D" pull -q --ff-only 2>&1 | tail -1; else git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/KristjanHS/dotfiles "$D" 2>&1 | tail -1; fi; DOTFILES="$D" bash "$D/scripts/cloud-link-config.sh" 2>&1 || echo 'cloud-link: FAILED (dotfiles clone or script error)'; exit 0
